mini_task_spec:
Read the file `test-repo/packages/common/utils/shared.utils.ts` and extract the `normalizePath` function. Execute that function in a sandboxed JavaScript/TypeScript environment for each of the following six inputs (in order): `undefined`, `''` (empty string), `'/'`, `'foo'`, `'/foo/bar/'`, and `'//foo//bar//'`. Report each result on its own line in the format `<input> => <output>`, where `undefined` is written as the bare word `undefined` and string values are double-quoted. The answer must list all six results in the order the inputs were given.
